content:
We have a new release candidate of Lean, v4.35.0-rc2. See the release notes for more information.

The usual repos are all available with the new toolchain at their respective v4.35.0-rc2 tags (and ProofWidgets at v0.0.113). We encourage all projects downstream to update to v4.35.0-rc2 when possible, and to release their own corresponding toolchain tags after updating.
